# M2 Health Information Provider: Create and link records

## In plain words

Milestone 2, sharing records as a [HIP](hip.md): turning your records
into [FHIR](fhir.md) bundles, grouping them into
[care contexts](/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/care-context), linking those to a patient's
[ABHA address](abha-address.md), answering [discovery](discovery.md), and
encrypting and pushing data when consent allows. See
[M2](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2).

## Before you start

Nothing. A glossary entry assumes no prior reading.

## What happens

Nothing happens here. This entry defines a term, it does not describe a call.

## How you know it worked

You have understood this when you can say whether your system holds records that other systems should be able to find.

## When it goes wrong

Assuming M2 alone makes records visible. Nothing you hold is
discoverable until a care context is linked.

reply.Text:
**M2** is Milestone 2 in the HIE-CM gateway specification. It covers the health information provider (HIP) functionality for:

- **Creating and linking records** — turning your records into FHIR bundles and grouping them into care contexts
- **Linking care contexts to ABHA addresses** — making records discoverable to a patient's ABHA address
- **Discovery** — answering discovery requests so other systems can find your records
- **Data sharing** — encrypting and pushing data when consent allows

In short: M2 is where you, as an HIP, make your patient records shareable and discoverable on the ABDM network. A key constraint to remember is that nothing you hold is discoverable until a care context is linked—M2 alone isn't enough.

See the HIE-CM developer portal's [M2 API documentation](https://docs.abdm.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2) for the full flow.
